## What problem does this solve?

A clear description of the gap or friction you're hitting.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. If this touches the scene graph, animation system, or
rendering pipeline, note how it fits the constraints in [CLAUDE.md](../../CLAUDE.md)
(typed `EditorOperation`s, deterministic renderer, semantic elements, etc.) —
proposals that require bypassing those will need a stronger justification.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why you didn't go with them.

## Additional context

Anything else — mockups, example projects, related issues.
